cards.claim: GDT813 compares two fixed readings of f17r.11 otchol cthar okaiin chol daiiin: N, Dieses Wurzelpulver: äußerst trocken?, versus G, Diese Wurzel ist äußerst trocken?. Both assume otchol=this, cthar=root, chol=dry and daiiin=very high degree; only okaiin changes, powder versus is. N requires nominal root/material composition and nominal predication; its colon is analytical, whereas G supplies an explicit copula. The other five paragraph lines remain untranslated. The reported isolated f88v.14 inscription gives a content-term investigation priority, but neither identifies powder nor excludes copular/elliptical uses: no unique label owner is established, the reported fragment is not powder, and an unpictured derived preparation is an additional N assumption. The favourable f88r.22 copula construction remains alongside N, with its head unknown. The unchanged scalar family and all repeated forms must survive transfer; no repeated daiin or cthar is removed and the radial context is retained. This is one unconfirmed whole-construction comparison, not two established lexical meanings or a victory over untested property/reference alternatives.

evidence.quote:
## Fixed alternatives and the actual paragraph

The source line f17r.11 is identical in the three alternate transcriptions:

`otchol cthar okaiin chol daiiin`

| Whole | N | G |
|---|---|---|
| otchol | dieses? | dieses? |
| cthar | Wurzel? | Wurzel? |
| okaiin | Pulver? | ist? |
| chol | trocken? | trocken? |
| daiiin | sehr hohe Ausprägung? | sehr hohe Ausprägung? |

N gives **„Dieses Wurzelpulver: äußerst trocken?“**, G gives
**„Diese Wurzel ist äußerst trocken?“**. N assumes a nominal part/material
composition and nominal predication; the colon is analytical. G assumes an
explicit copula. Both spend three newly proposed word identities. No word
is dropped, but fluency supplies neither their identities nor their grammar.
The old cthar=herb-material and okaiin=hot-III defaults from GDT628 are rival
assignments, not independent support. otchol is not cold-dry inside this trial.

The other five lines are not translated. Alternate-reader omissions, splits
and substitutions remain in CONTEXTS.tsv and the visual note. All thirteen
f17r loci are retained, including the separate marginal record with an empty
IT2a reading. A physical line is not automatically a sentence.

| Context | Consequence with the same meanings |
|---|---|
| f88v.14, L: `okaiin` in all three readings | Visually isolated inscription near a plant fragment. Pure „ist“ needs an extra account of an unwritten subject/complement or a special use. A substance, class, property or reference could stand here; none is identified. |
| f89r1.14, L: `okaiin dan`, reader-exact | N permits „sehr wenig Pulver?“ under unchanged family A; G permits an incomplete „ist sehr wenig“. Neither establishes what is being measured or named. No new visual-owner authentication here. |
| f72r3.12, L: `opoeey okaiin`, reader-exact | Keep the radial-register occurrence. opoeey remains unknown. This turn checks its text, not a new picture-owner relation; a universal pharmaceutical substance identity owes an explanation. |
| f88r.22: `ychey okaiin chol cheor ol chorcholsal`, reader-exact | The favourable G construction `[ychey] ist trocken ...` is retained beside N's nominal alternative. The unknown subject and following words prevent a decision. |
| f32v.8: `otchol daiin daiin ...` | Shared demonstrative otchol needs a pronominal/anaphoric quantity construction, not only a determiner before a noun. No hidden noun is identified; neither daiin is deleted. |
| f1r.2: `cthar cthar dan` within the line | The repeated proposed root is retained. Its coordination, emphasis or segmentation remains unexplained; no second organ is invented. |
| f4r.3: `otchol chol ...` | A demonstrative-plus-property account is possible, but f17r does not establish an obligatory two-slot frame or universally required copula. |

All 54 complete selected loci, including unfavourable and alternate-only
matches, were read in the coordinating synthesis. These are NOT all complete
external paragraphs. C and L source kinds remain separate; not every non-P
record is a standalone plant label. For example f72r2.32 is a longer C record
with two exact okaiin occurrences, not two authenticated pictured owners.

The linguistic agent initially preferred G as a pointed copula question, then
put N first after the label review without changing a gloss. That revision
is recorded, not presented as a blinded success. A standalone label does
not logically disprove all copular, existential, elliptical or metalinguistic
uses. Nor does N outrank an untested content-property model by this comparison.

On the correct Yale1006233 f88v region, both manual reviewers see the target
as a short isolated inscription in the second illustrated band, separate
from the prose above and below. No leader or caption box uniquely assigns
it to a root, leaf, whole specimen or group. The visible fragment has leaves;
it is not powder. An unpictured derived preparation is possible but is an
additional N hypothesis. Exact official URLs, hashes and limits are in
src/SOURCE_REGISTER.tsv; no new manuscript page was admitted.

2026-09-05. Alle folgenden Wortbedeutungen sind C0: unbestätigte Arbeitshypothesen.

`otchol cthar okaiin chol daiiin` auf f17r.11 lässt zwei konkrete Versuche zu:

- N: **„Dieses Wurzelpulver: äußerst trocken?“**
- G: **„Diese Wurzel ist äußerst trocken?“**

Beide halten die gleichen Annahmen fest: otchol=dieses, cthar=Wurzel,
chol=trocken und daiiin=sehr hohe Ausprägung. Nur okaiin unterscheidet sich:
Pulver oder ist. Der Doppelpunkt in N ist unsere nominale Satzanalyse,
kein entschlüsseltes Wort. Es gibt keinen belegten Mahlvorgang.

Die nützlichste neue Beobachtung liegt außerhalb dieser schönen Zeile:
Auf f88v.14 steht okaiin als isolierte kurze Inschrift bei einem
Pflanzenfragment. Das Bild zeigt die Trennung von der benachbarten Prosa;
alle drei alternativen Lesungen geben dasselbe einzelne Wort wieder.
Als reines „ist“ braucht das eine zusätzliche Erklärung; als Stoffname,
Klasse, Eigenschaft oder Referenzwert kann es unmittelbar eine Inschrift sein.
Deshalb jetzt zuerst die inhaltstragende Lesart weiterverfolgen, nicht die
Kopula zum Standard machen. G bleibt möglich, kein deduktiver Ausschluss.

Das identifiziert ausdrücklich **nicht Pulver**. Das Bild zeigt ein
Pflanzenfragment mit Blättern, keinen Pulverhaufen; ein eindeutiger Besitzer
des Labels ist nicht abgegrenzt. Ebenso hat Wurzel noch keinen unabhängigen
